scope: Supplemental cosmetic appearance mappings for curated guides. These do not change identity, ingredients, removal, exclusion or personal suitability gates.

patches.note: Official page describes twelve wearable eye shades, smooth blending and a base-then-depth application. Mapped to softly blended eye color as a cosmetic technique, not a guaranteed result or personal shade match. The palette contains mixed finishes; no single finish is assigned.

Official page identifies a shadow, blush and highlighter palette and instructs even eye-color application with a brush or finger. Mapped to a softly applied wash of eye color; this is an editorial technique choice, not a personal shade match or a finish claim.
